(transaction FPSA).

Features

By specifying the selection criteria in the dunning proposal run, you control which items are dunned. By specifying a dunning
procedure, you control the actions carried out during dunning (see Dunning Procedures).

A successfully completed dunning proposal run is therefore the prerequisite for executing dunning activities.

Activities
1. To do this, in the SAP menu, choose |}Periodic Processing » For Contract Accounts » Dunning » Dunning Proposal Run
(transaction FPVA).

2. Enter a date and an ID that you can use to identify the run later.

3. On the General Selections tab, enter the parameters that the program should use to select the items to be dunned. Using
the dynamic selections, you can select the fields of the item (table DFKKOP).

For selecting business partners or contract accounts, you can also use preselections for master data. Using these
preselections, the system checks the specified master records against the interval limits of the mass activity, as if you had
entered these as individual values for the business partner/contract account. In each interval, therefore, the system
processes only those master records that are both within the interval limits and are part of the preselection.

To switch back and forth between direct selection and preselection, choose the pushbuttons Ry Preselection (Switch to

Preselection) and ay Direct Selection (Switch to Direct Selection) next to the input fields for the business partner and
contract account.

By choosing the (| Detail pushbutton, you can display the preselection that was entered.
4. On the Dunning Parameters tab, specify the following parameters required for the dunning notices:

o Net due date of the items to be dunned (optional)

o Date of issue of the dunning notices

As the date of issue, enter the date on which you plan to print the dunning notices. The system proposes the current
date. Using the issue date, the system determines the days in arrears for the item due and the interval to the last
dunning notice for the business partner.

Using execution variants, you can postprocess the dunning proposal on the basis of any company-specific criteria in
event 300.

If you set the Start Activity Run indicator, when you start the dunning proposal run, the system automatically starts
the dunning activity run as well.
